Name: Self Serve
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
I know there are already a couple of mods that do this, but neither is officially compatible and they don't do what I needed anyway, so I made my own.

This works with:

[list]
[*]Pierre's
[*]Willy's
[*]Sandy's
[*]Marnie's
[*]Robin's
[*]Hospital
[*]Saloon
[*]Blacksmith
[*]Ice Cream Stand
[*]Resort Bar

[/list]

[b][size=5]Notes[/size][/b]

You can also access the blacksmith shop while a tool is being upgraded.

This mod also removes the direction restriction, so you can access shops from any angle.

Access to each of the shops can be toggled in the config either using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM [/url]or editing the config.json file created after running the game.


[size=5][b]Technical[/b][/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url], uses Harmony.

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6338]Mod Updater[/url]﻿ for automatic updates.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].

﻿﻿If you want to complain or ask for help or help me test my mods, you can visit [url=https://discord.gg/bs6zHuj]my Discord server﻿[/url].

A list of all my mods for Stardew Valley is available at [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895[/url].
